label: Brisnik: antidepressant with a history of falls
title: Any antidepressant in a person with a history of falls
statement: Prescribed any antidepressant - and the patient has a history of falls

source.document: Brisnik V, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: indicators of high-risk and overprescribing. BMC Med 2024;22:193, Tables 3-4
source.citation: Brisnik V, Vukas J, Jung-Sievers C, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: development of indicators of high-risk and overprescribing using the RAND/UCLA Appropriateness Method. BMC Med 2024;22:193. doi:10.1186/s12916-024-03397-w

plain_summary: Antidepressants can cause dizziness, drowsiness and falls. A person who has already fallen is at higher risk, so the need for the antidepressant should be reviewed.

medicine_groups.name: Antidepressants (any)
medicine_groups.note: All antidepressant classes count, at any dose: SSRI, SNRI, mirtazapine, tricyclics, trazodone, tranylcypromine, moclobemide, phenelzine, agomelatine, vortioxetine, reboxetine and mianserin. Bupropion sold for quitting smoking is not counted. Dosulepin is also called dothiepin. Generic packs that show the ingredient name with a company name count too.

needs_facts.meets: Either a dated condition or a dated observation explicitly records at least one previous fall.

options.words: At least one previous fall by the time of the antidepressant supply
No previous fall by the time of that supply

rule_for_models: With a Group A antidepressant, cite the supply and a dated condition, dated observation or pharmacist answer confirming at least one previous fall by the time of that supply. The exact fall date is unnecessary when the history or pharmacist confirms that it applies to this course. Do not apply an undated answer to a completed course unless the answer places the fall before or during it. A later report of no further falls does not erase a previous fall. If the record or pharmacist confirms no previous fall by the time of that supply and there is no contrary evidence, give no finding for that supply. If history or timing is unknown, report a possible finding and name "History of falls" for the supply being assessed.
cannot_be_seen: Falls and their circumstances may go unrecorded. How the person walks, vision, blood pressure on standing, and medicines bought without a prescription or supplied by a hospital or another pharmacy.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm whether the person has fallen before? If so, could you assess falls risk and review whether the antidepressant is still needed or its dose could be reduced?
